definition: Each observed strict training-program event contributes exactly one logged new_utility minus old_utility increment. ECDF counts events equally, conditional on a strict event; zero-event rounds are counted in the window denominator but do not become zero-gain observations. No aggregation into overall model or independent performance.
scope: Adaptive training-side journal observations; distinct from adapter admissions, independent first proposals, Elo and serving performance. Source/adapter/evaluation-population/normalization binding remains unqualified.
